name: Syntra
long_description:
Syntra’s mission is to make healthcare faster, starting with healthcare payments.

Syntra Autonomous, our first product, automates pre-bill chart review, claim review, and submission.

In the 12 months since launch, Syntra Autonomous has processed more than 1 million patient encounters and over $200 million in insurance collections across hundreds of practice locations nationwide.

If you’re interested in building toward infinitely fast healthcare, reach out!
